name: sapi-pro-monorepo
description: sapi-pro monorepo：packages/core 共享源码，variants/beta 与 variants/stable 双渠道构建发布

scripts.install:variants: npm --prefix variants/beta install && npm --prefix variants/stable install
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:beta && npm run typecheck:stable
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm run compile:beta && npm run compile:stable && npm run package
scripts.build:beta: npm run typecheck:beta && npm run compile:beta
scripts.build:stable: npm run typecheck:stable && npm run compile:stable
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run pack:beta && npm run pack:stable
